ItemID: NA; Title: CHANZON 100 pcs 5mm RGB Multicolor Fast Blinking (Multi Color Changing) Dynamics LED Diode Lights (Flashing Round DC) Bright Lighting Bulb Lamps Electronics Components Flicker Light Emitting Diodes; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Automatically flashing LEDs are too specialized for the general prototyping supplies I have used.
ItemID: NA; Title: OCR 24Value 500pcs Electrolytic Capacitor Assortment Box Kit Range 0.1uF－1000uF; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this assortment to have useful capacitor values available for breadboard and PCB projects.
ItemID: NA; Title: BNTECHGO 24 AWG Magnet Wire - Enameled Copper Wire - Enameled Magnet Winding Wire - 1.0 lb - 0.0197" Diameter 1 Spool Coil Red Temperature Rating 155℃ Widely Used for Transformers Inductors; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could complement my ferrite cores, but I would wait until I have a specific winding project before buying a full spool.
ItemID: NA; Title: WGGE WG-026 10 Pieces and 5 Colors Test Lead Set & Alligator Clips,20.5 inches / 22 AWG Wire (2 Pack); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose these for convenient temporary connections while testing my boards and power circuits.
ItemID: NA; Title: McIgIcM Transistor Kit, 200 Pcs 10 Values BC337 BC327 2N2222 2N2907 2N3904 2N3906 S8050 S8550 A1015 C1815 Assortment; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for experimenting with switching circuits alongside my breadboards and relay module.
ItemID: NA; Title: CO RODE 3mm and 5mm LED Lights Emitting Diodes Assortment Set Kit for Arduino Bright White Red Blue Green Yellow, 300-Pack; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my electronics projects, but my earlier PCB kit included LEDs, so I would check my remaining supply first.
ItemID: NA; Title: EDGELEC 100pcs 75 ohm Resistor 1/4w (0.25 Watt) ±1% Tolerance Metal Film Fixed Resistor, Multiple Values of Resistance Optional; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a clear need for a hundred resistors of this particular value right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: DiCUNO 500Pcs (5 Colors x 100P) 3MM Light Emitting Diode, White/Red/Yellow/Green/Blue Bright Diffused LED Diodes Assorted Kit for Electronic Project, Science Experiments; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Basic indicator LEDs are relevant, but this quantity is more than I would choose without a project requiring them.
ItemID: NA; Title: Transistor Tester, DROK Mosfet Transistor Capacitor Tester, Mega328 NPN PNP Transistor Diode Resistor Inductor Capacitance MOS SCR ESR Meter Automatic Checker Detector; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Component identification sounds useful, but I would hold off until troubleshooting becomes a regular need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hantek PP-200 Oscilloscope Probes (Pack of 2), 200MHz; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need to confirm that I have a compatible oscilloscope and need replacement probes before choosing these.
